mentions.claim_text: He reads that a fireball weighed 5.6 metric tons, more than twelve thousand pounds, travelling at forty two thousand miles an hour, and recalls saying they would not be able to shoot it down with a rocket.
mentions.quote: they won't be able to shoot it down with a rocket
mentions.falsify_match: An object that cannot be intercepted approaches Earth.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ordinary meteors, which are not intercepted because they are not threats.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said there is something about Malibu, that he did not even know where it was and had to be shown on a map, and that it is in California.
mentions.quote: I didn't even know where it was. They had to show me on the map
mentions.falsify_match: A notable event at Malibu.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He states his own unfamiliarity with the place, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is what is happening now and that they are burning everything just as he saw two years ago, that he saw things in trash cans, and that it took two years for the word to come to pass, with black swan events coming.
mentions.quote: it took two years for that word to come to pass
mentions.falsify_match: The 2024 word matches the 2026 unrest on a specific detail.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only the general fact of burning matches, which is common to most civil unrest.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the object went over Boston very loudly and that people there were alarmed by the noise.
mentions.quote: it really went over Boston really loud
mentions.falsify_match: A bright loud bolide over the American northeast.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a 6.2 earthquake in the water by the Italian boot and says he saw an underwater volcano getting ready to go off there that will cause over three hundred thousand people to perish.
mentions.quote: it will cause over 300,000 people to perish
mentions.falsify_match: An Italian undersea eruption killing hundreds of thousands.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is outside and not on land, something to watch and pray about, that he is not trying to bring fear, and notes a record breaking forty eight eruptions.
mentions.quote: I'm not trying to bring fear
mentions.falsify_match: An unusual global run of eruptions.

mentions.claim_text: He remarks that it was the government of Mexico rather than America that found it, and says something his son showed him about the fires and something underground bothered him a lot.
mentions.quote: it's the government of Mexico, not America, that found this
mentions.falsify_match: An American intelligence failure is exposed in a Mexican discovery.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He does not say what was found.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a Christian conservative candidate ahead in the polls, and says this is what he saw about a red wave coming to Los Angeles and California with a revival coming out of it.
mentions.quote: a red wave coming to Los Angeles, a red wave coming to California
mentions.falsify_match: Conservative gains in Los Angeles followed by a religious movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is what they were praying over, that he saw them rolling out digital identity very quickly with social credit scores in Australia.
mentions.quote: going to roll out digital ID very quick and social credit scores
mentions.falsify_match: Australian digital identity with social credit scoring.
mentions.falsify_miss: Digital identity without scoring, or neither.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the president complaining that he cannot do his job for negotiating with political hacks who tell him to move faster or slower or go to war or not, and telling people to sit back and relax because it always works out.
mentions.quote: Just sit back and relax. It will all work out well
mentions.falsify_match: The situation resolves as claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He says when Israel pushes the button great antisemitism will rise in New York and across America, that Jewish people will be hurt and will flee home to Israel, and names a ministry helping them.
mentions.quote: Israel pushes the button and great anti-semitism will rise up
mentions.falsify_match: An Israeli strike followed by a measurable rise in American antisemitism and emigration.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw someone with serious health problems that he will only call the C word, who did not make it, seen while praying into the months ahead.
mentions.quote: it would be the C word and that's all I will say
mentions.falsify_match: A named public figure dies of cancer in that period.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He names nobody, so almost any such death could be claimed.

mentions.claim_text: Looking at what appears to be a Mexican restaurant scene, he asks what he is praying over, prays over the umbrellas and the people, and says they are drunk but not as though they have had too much.
mentions.quote: I see people down here they're drunk
mentions.falsify_match: The scene resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no reading is offered.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has been praying over the basketball crowd and a named downtown park, that the team lost in the seventh game, and that he sees something trying to happen there.
mentions.quote: thunder lost in the seventh game
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a gathering in that park.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not scolding but trying to put some fire into the audience, and refers to children bowing down to a false god.
mentions.quote: You need a little bit of gasoline on your little flames
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an exhortation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will all be thanking God the president is in office rather than her, and that he keeps seeing a red dawn experience with an enemy within and a Trojan within, because they were not able to attack from foreign countries.
mentions.quote: I keep seeing this red dawn experience. an enemy within, a Trojan within
mentions.falsify_match: An attack from cells already inside America.

mentions.claim_text: He says that after they prayed the night before, the president posted about a named former regulator and an anti-crypto army nearly destroying the American crypto industry.
mentions.quote: after what we prayed last night, he comes on here and says this
mentions.falsify_match: American crypto policy shifts decisively.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The post follows their prayer by a day, which he treats as significant.

mentions.claim_text: He says the president will never let crypto down and that the new frontier of finance is being built in America, tying it to the new industrial revolution and the black line he says the Lord showed them.
mentions.quote: the new industrial revolution, the black line the Lord showed us
mentions.falsify_match: American crypto legislation and a financial technology boom.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Cuba being called a threat to American national security and says the greatest revival Cuba has ever seen is about to happen, and that he knows what the Lord has shown him.
mentions.quote: the greatest revival Cuba has ever seen is about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised Cuban revival.

mentions.claim_text: He wonders what will happen with New York now that Ramadan is over, and turns to a claim that the former president had a stroke on stage during a debate.
mentions.quote: I'm curious what will happen now with New York or Ramadan's over
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable follows in New York.

mentions.claim_text: He says it has been a slow and boring news day with nothing else, and notes a report that the president is going to war with the cartels.
mentions.quote: They're saying he's going to war with the cartels
mentions.falsify_match: American military action against the cartels.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that a named Miami ministry will have the largest turnout it has ever had and that its pastor will have a major harvest of souls in Brazil, calling the harvest in now.
mentions.quote: Pastor Maldonado will have a major harvest of souls in Brazil
mentions.falsify_match: Record attendance at those meetings.

mentions.claim_text: He says he can see the coffee shops and downtown of the area empty, then sees the president talking with the secretary of state right next to him.
mentions.quote: I can see very clearly the Starbucks and these ones downtown are empty
mentions.falsify_match: A visible collapse in retail and hospitality footfall.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the number 250, green oak trees, signs on poles reading 250 America, and a major parade in Washington, noting that it is going down.
mentions.quote: I see signs on poles that says 250 America
mentions.falsify_match: A large anniversary parade in Washington.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The parade was already announced by this date.

mentions.claim_text: He says a man he cannot identify is behind it but is getting pressure from the king, from England and from Europe, with two others on his left and right, and calls it persecution.
mentions.quote: he's getting it from pressure from the king, from England
mentions.falsify_match: Coordinated religious persecution traced to British influence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. He says he does not know who the man is.

mentions.claim_text: He says social credit scores are coming to copy China, that they are in the last of the last days, and that this will affect New Zealand too.
mentions.quote: social credit scores are coming like to copy China
mentions.falsify_match: Social credit scoring introduced in those countries.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will experience the greatest outpouring ever seen and asks whether they can take the land for Jesus in Cuba, Venezuela, Brazil and Thailand.
mentions.quote: can we take the land for Jesus in Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Recognised movements in all four.

mentions.claim_text: He says the doubt and unbelief of the old generation is that they have never seen it before, and that God said he is examining his troops and some will not make it to what he has called them to.
mentions.quote: I'm examining my troops and there'll be some that will not make it
mentions.falsify_match: Prominent ministry failures.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occur. No one is named, so any failure would be claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is high enough to see what is coming, that Rome fell and America will be humbled and shaken to awaken, and that they have a window of opportunity they are praying for the president through.
mentions.quote: America will be humbled and shaken to awaken
mentions.falsify_match: A national humbling followed by religious resurgence.

mentions.claim_text: He shows something happening in English schools that day and says this is coming to America in the coming days if the country does not wake up.
mentions.quote: this is coming to America if you don't wake up
mentions.falsify_match: The same measure is introduced in American schools.

mentions.claim_text: He says crowds across Iran are still chanting death to America on video while America is trying to liberate and help them, and says he does not understand it.
mentions.quote: crying out death to America all across over in Iran right now
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian public opinion stays hostile after the campaign.

mentions.claim_text: He says God speaks to him in a still small voice while he pulls weeds and then it gets loud, and that he was told about the Indian prime minister that day, seeing the plans and oil fields burning.
mentions.quote: he talked to me about Modi today
mentions.falsify_match: An Indian role in the oil conflict emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He identifies an island he has been praying over and says he sees it burning, with major attacks coming that wipe out the oil infrastructure across it, citing satellite fire data.
mentions.quote: A major attacks coming and wiping the infrastructure of this oil
mentions.falsify_match: An island oil terminal destroyed.

mentions.claim_text: He says China and India were going to Russia to work out their oil supply, and that the island he saw completely engulfed in flames is now happening a little but not to the extreme he saw.
mentions.quote: it's happening a little bit. Not to the extreme that I saw
mentions.falsify_match: The island is fully engulfed as described.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only partial damage occurs. He states the gap himself rather than claiming the partial as the fulfilment.

mentions.claim_text: He contrasts a scattershot with hitting the bullseye, saying that praying in the spirit and pushing into the river takes you where he wants you that day, concerning Israel.
mentions.quote: It's like having a scatter shot versus hitting the bullseye
mentions.falsify_match: His claims narrow rather than broaden.
mentions.falsify_miss: They continue to be given in scattershot form.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the number 911 and the American flag on a building that has fallen, a major building fallen, and calls it a new ground zero.
mentions.quote: I see a major building that has fallen. A new ground zero
mentions.falsify_match: A major American building is destroyed in an attack.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats a new ground zero with smoke, a building and rubble, mentions harbingers, and says the time is up.
mentions.quote: I see a great ground zero, a new ground zero
mentions.falsify_match: A mass casualty attack on American soil.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a floor going up in a perfect even golden circle into another one above it, with the Lord saying that is what he is praying into, and the American flag visible.
mentions.quote: it went up in a golden curb, a beautiful round circle
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no reading is offered.

mentions.claim_text: He says all eight thousand watching could change the nations, that against eight billion people there are eight thousand here, and that God does not need many.
mentions.quote: All 8,000 of you. God could change the nations
mentions.falsify_match: The audience produces a visible national effect.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is something there he has not got yet, sees a faucet and a man standing under an open heaven, and says it concerns a named church and minister that the Lord keeps on his heart.
mentions.quote: he'll stand underneath an open heaven
mentions.falsify_match: A revival at that named church.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is something about 911 with this, repeats a new ground zero and a flag, and says he saw America burning and fire, comparing it to soldiers raising a flag on a hill.
mentions.quote: There's something about 911 with this
mentions.falsify_match: A mass casualty attack followed by a flag raising image.

mentions.claim_text: He says old chapters are closing and a brand new one is beginning, that this is the final chapter and the revival, and that looking at a named minister's face in the spirit he saw fireworks and it is the finale.
mentions.quote: This is the final chapter. This is it. The revival
mentions.falsify_match: A final great revival before the end.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Finale language has no defined end, so it cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man in a tuxedo shirt, says he saw President Kennedy and the Lord said the Kennedy curse, saw the Cuban missile crisis and was told to pay attention to Cuba, and could see missiles.
mentions.quote: I saw President Kennedy and the Lord said the Kennedy curse
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuba crisis on Kennedy era lines.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something going very high off a boat in the Gulf toward Mar-a-Lago, acknowledges the radar coverage and that it would be almost impossible, and wonders how high you could go without being seen.
mentions.quote: I know we've got lots of radar and it'd be almost near impossible
mentions.falsify_match: A launch from a boat in the Gulf.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He raises the practical objection himself, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the mafia families saying it is just business but that it was personal because they did not like how the new man over New York runs things and wanted to stop some things, and saw the five families.
mentions.quote: it was personal to them cuz they didn't like the way this new guy
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime moves against the city administration.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man could put the storm in his hand and did not move off the steps, standing looking out over New York the whole time, and that he saw a brand new glass Trump Tower being built which shot up.
mentions.quote: I saw a brand new Trump Tower being built
mentions.falsify_match: A new Trump tower is built in New York.

mentions.claim_text: He says something with Iran and that they will pray, notes the last two videos have been different, and is shown Iranian flights.
mentions.quote: something with Iran, but we're going to pray
mentions.falsify_match: An Iranian escalation follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says if you work God's system it will work for you, that seed is multiplied thirty, sixty or a hundredfold, and that you should look at that account as you would a bank balance.
mentions.quote: if you work God's system, it will work for you
mentions.falsify_match: Givers see returns at that multiple.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. The condition puts any shortfall on the giver.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what about the churches in Chicago, Philadelphia, New York, Miami and Atlanta that need a touch and are desperate, and says God stationed him in a small place.
mentions.quote: What about the churches in Chicago? What about the churches in Philadelphia
mentions.falsify_match: Revival in those named cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says at the same time he sees an attack against Israel by Syria, a surprise attack where they have infiltrated within, and that he told them it would be worse.
mentions.quote: I see a surprise attack where they have infiltrated within
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack on Israel out of Syria by infiltrators.

mentions.claim_text: He says Iran is planning a surprise attack and not to underestimate the enemy, and prays over a named carrier, the boats, the infrastructure and the military bases.
mentions.quote: Iran is planning a surprise attack. Don't underestimate your enemy
mentions.falsify_match: An Iranian surprise attack on American forces.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the named carrier, the boats, the ships, the battleships and the military bases throughout the Gulf.
mentions.quote: We pray over our battleships. We pray over our military bases
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on an American vessel or base.

mentions.claim_text: He hears a signal like sonar, a repeated ping, running down to South America, and says it is a mathematical code that only they know.
mentions.quote: I hear a signal. Kind of like a sonar
mentions.falsify_match: A covert signalling network to South America is uncovered.

mentions.claim_text: He sees great earthquakes shaking California and San Francisco and in the water, volcanoes erupting, great shaking all over Italy and a major volcano erupting.
mentions.quote: I see great earthquakes shaking California. I see great shaking all over Italy
mentions.falsify_match: Major earthquakes in California and Italy with an eruption.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are threats against their lives, sees some in Houston and Texas, and that major shaking is coming to individual churches and megachurches.
mentions.quote: I'm talking about individual churches, mega churches. I'm seeing shaking
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks or scandals at named megachurches.
